text:
If you can steal an outdoor break today, this is the one to take. Burlington starts clear and cold, but full sunshine should lift us to a high right around 58, with light wind and no rain to get in the way. Skies stay mostly clear tonight, though temperatures slide back to about 35, so you’ll want a jacket after sunset.

Thursday stays mostly sunny and dry, but the high is the uncertain part: the official forecast says 55, while the model spread runs from 49 to 56. I’d lean toward the milder side, though it’ll feel cooler than today, especially with a stronger breeze and gusts nearing 30 mph. The dry stretch is also raising brush-fire concerns, so skip outdoor burning. Today is the better day for a long walk or ride, with the clearest skies and gentlest conditions.
